title: Model-Guided Design of Nanoparticle Dispersity through Process-Chain Optimization
summary: The design of high-quality nanoparticles requires the production of materials with narrow particle size distributions, as these strongly influence the functionalities of the final product. To achieve this goal, it is useful to consider a coupled process chain in which nanoparticles are first synthesized and subsequently fractionated by chromatographic separation. We introduce a novel mathematical optimization model for the integrated optimization of coupled nanoparticle synthesis and separation processes.
